summary: Completed backend+frontend regression for curated fonts, zoom/camera export invariants, template simple/free workflows, and legacy invalid-draft blocking.

issues: Loading state uses class name containing 'error' (studio-canvas-error), which can create false positives in automated error scans.

action_items: Optional: rename non-error loading CSS class ('studio-canvas-error') to avoid false-positive QA/error-monitoring signals.
Optional manual follow-up: real touch-device pinch gesture validation (multi-touch) for final release sign-off.
critical_code_review_comments: Outdated legacy font install/paging tests were still present; updated tests now enforce curated-manifest contract (25 families / 177 variants) and retired install endpoint 404.
Export flow correctly preserves user camera state via try/finally while generating canonical 800x800 output.
Live transform telemetry via data-live-element is emitted during transform and clamps invalid oversized/rotated image/text transforms to last valid geometry.

success_rate.backend: 100% pass on active suite (48 passed, 1 skipped)
success_rate.frontend: ~96% for requested critical flows (zoom, templates, fonts, export, save/cart, responsive, legacy-invalid blocking, live-transform telemetry)

seed_data_creation: Created transient guest sessions, transient uploads, and one temporary DB-inserted legacy-invalid draft (cleaned up in test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: No functional blockers found. High-value checks completed: curated font dropdown count=25, no Google/CDN font requests on switch, download remains 800x800 independent of zoom/pan, template placeholder gating works, undo/redo mode transitions work, localStorage legacy invalid design preserved+blocked. Multi-touch pinch specifically was not hardware-validated in this run.
rca of the issue: RCA (test-side): prior regressions were caused by obsolete assumptions about old font catalog/install APIs. Current implementation uses fixed curated manifest via GET /api/studio/fonts and intentionally removed runtime install route (404). Tests were updated to align with approved contract.
